selected_script.hook: Stop bending over to grab your charger off the floor every single day.

usage_steps_used: Flip open the hinged clear cover
Place the cable into the open center groove
Release cover to let the magnet snap it shut automatically

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Close-up of a white USB charger cable sliding off a smooth desk and falling behind furniture, a person's hand reaches for it with frustration. 3-6s: On a clean, dry, flat desk surface, the Peach/Orange squarish magnetic cable clip is shown. A hand flips open the hinged clear cover upward, places the horizontal cable into the 7.55mm open center groove, and releases the cover so it snaps shut automatically using internal magnets. 6-10s: Fast-cut Scene 1: Close-up of the organized cable sitting neatly on the desk edge inside the peach/orange clip.
video_001_part_01.audio: Tired of your charging cables sliding off your desk every time you unplug? Just place your cable inside, let it snap shut, and keep it right where you need it.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: Fast-cut Scene 2: The peach/orange clip mounted on a clean, dry nightstand surface holding a bedside phone charger wire securely. 4-8s: Fast-cut Scene 3: The peach/orange clip on a smooth car dashboard holding a black AUX media cord horizontally. 8-10s: A light CTA showing the organized clean desk, text overlay reads: 'Keep your charging cables in place.'
video_001_part_02.audio: Perfect for your desk, nightstand, or car. Keep your space clean and cozier.
